s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Pad Switch Assembly (w/o Shift Paddle Switch)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 pins and claw, and temporarily install the steering pad switch RH side.
Engage the clamp.
Install the steering pad switch RH side with the screw.
Engage the 2 pins and claw, and temporarily install the steering pad switch LH side.
Install the steering pad switch assembly to the steering wheel assembly with the screw.

s-1.ptxt: Check that Front Tires are Facing Straight Ahead (w/ Shift Paddle Switch)
Spiral Cable Centering (w/ Shift Paddle Switch)

s2.ptxt: Check that the IG is OFF.
Check that the battery negative terminal is disconnected.

atten3.ptxt: After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Slowly turn the spiral cable counterclockwise until it locks.

item.ptxt: To prevent breaking the spiral cable, turn it gently without applying force.
Do not turn the spiral cable 2.5 or more turns left or right from the matchmark, as it may break.

atten4.ptxt: The spiral cable rotates approximately 5 turns maximum.

s2.ptxt: From the locked position, turn the spiral cable back 2.5 turns clockwise and align the matchmarks shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Wheel Assembly (w/ Shift Paddle Switch)

s2.ptxt: Align the matchmarks and install the steering wheel assembly to the steering column assembly.
Install the nut.
Connect each connector to the spiral cable.

s-1.ptxt: Check Steering Wheel Assembly Center Position (w/ Shift Paddle Switch)

s2.ptxt: Make sure that the ignition switch is OFF.
Check that the battery negative terminal is disconnected.

atten2.ptxt: After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Connect the airbag connector to the horn button assembly.
Push in the lock of the airbag connector.
Connect the horn connector to the horn button assembly in the direction shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: If connected in the wrong direction, it will be difficult to disconnect the horn connector.

s2.ptxt: Push in the horn button assembly to engage the 2 pins and install the horn button assembly to the steering wheel assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.3

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 3 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Engage the 3 claws to install steering wheel cover LWR No.3.

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 4 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws to install steering wheel cover LWR No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Install Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.2

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 3 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Engage the 3 claws to install steering wheel cover LWR No.2.

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 4 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws to install steering wheel cover LWR No.2.

s2.ptxt: Check that the warning light comes on when the IG is turned ON.
Check that the warning light goes off approximately 6 seconds after the IG is turned ON.

item.ptxt: If the warning light remains on even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, there is a malfunction in the airbag/pretensioner system.

If the light comes on occasionally even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, a short to +B, short to ground or open circuit in the airbag warning light circuit may be the cause.
If the light comes on even with the IG OFF or ACC ON, a malfunction in the power supply system or combination meter assembly may be the cause.
